title: Request for Repatriation of Human Remains to New Zealand: Trustees' minutes (April 2008)
author: British Museum

notes.text: This page records the British Museum Trustees' April 2008 consideration of Te Papa Tongarewa's request concerning Māori ancestral remains, alongside the published dossier. It is relevant as a dated institutional decision record. The page reports that nine bone fragments were to be transferred and that the request for seven preserved tattooed heads was not agreed; this source record makes no claim about the subsequent completion or present status of either outcome. No object identity is established. Full-page redistribution terms were not established during review, so no local capture is registered.
